'''Fiordland Linux''' is an Arch-based Linux distribution named after the Fiordland penguin (tawaki). It aims to be fast and stable for gaming, development and everyday use, and friendly to people new to Linux.

== Components ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Part !! What it does
|-
| [[tawaki]] || Package manager. One command for the Arch repos, Flathub and the AUR.
|-
| rawaru || Graphical installer. Disk setup, desktop choice, drivers.
|-
| crest || Fiordland's own Hyprland shell, one of the desktop options.
|-
| fiordland-desktop || Defaults: theme, icons, fonts, shell prompt, mirror ranking.
|}

== Base system ==
* Arch Linux repositories, plus the <code>[fiordland]</code> repo (signed) and CachyOS's <code>[cachyos]</code> repo for the kernel.
* Kernel: <code>linux-cachyos</code> by default, with the Arch <code>linux</code> kernel kept as a second boot entry.
* Btrfs with snapper snapshots you can boot from the GRUB menu, zram swap.
* Installs on a whole disk, next to Windows, or on partitions you choose.
* New releases arrive through updates; no reinstall needed.
* Enabled out of the box: NetworkManager, Bluetooth, printing (CUPS with network printer discovery), firewall (ufw), firmware updates (fwupd), power profiles, mirror ranking, package cache cleanup, early out-of-memory handling (systemd-oomd).
